delivered.body: Share Purchase Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between the Seller and Meridian Acquisitions LLC as Buyer. 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller the purchase price for the Shares, in an amount to be agreed in writing by the parties and set forth in this Agreement before signing. 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days of signing. 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements are accurate. 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller indemnifies the Buyer against undisclosed liabilities.
